verdict.text: The change does what the plan says.

`scripts/release_notes.py` walks main's first-parent history between the previous release tag and the given one, sorts ticket merges and plain commits into two sections, skips the noise the plan lists, and fills `.github/release-notes.md`.
`release-tag.yml` now writes the notes with the script and publishes them with `--notes-file`.
The tests check each eval row's failure condition, and ADR 0012 matches the code.
I found nothing to fix.
Gates: `loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree gave all green: lint, format, tests, integration and eval rows r1 to r6 pass, stamp 6ef025dcf2bd0a6435bd9e237af4c8be94f2b4a4542925a80e5e0ad8adbfbefd.
`prek run --files` on the changed files passed too (kmctl check, ruff, okf validate --strict).
Code read in full: the script, the template, the new test file, the workflow and test_workflows diffs, the ADR 0012 addition and the summary.md re-ack.
The summary's `checked.against` list shrinking to 0012 alone is what `kmctl summary ack` writes (the concepts changed since the last check), not lost data.
Workflow: checkout uses fetch-depth 0, so tags are there.
On a raised run the tag is created locally before the publish step, and on a resume run it is fetched, so the script's unknown-tag refusal never fires wrongly.
Under `set -euo pipefail` a failed script fails the step before `gh release create` runs.
The previous-tag rule (packaging Version, pre-releases included) matches the old `sort -V` pipeline it replaces.
Real history: I ran the script for all 12 tags.
Every range has entries under What changed (v0.2.0 has 41; most have 1 to 8).
Other changes hold no `loop:`, `release:`, release PR or branch-sync lines.
v0.10.0 shows drop-summary-nudge and the uv cache commit (r5).
The template's install lines match the forms the README and docs use.
r1: the sections test checks exact section contents and that commits before v0.1.0, after v0.2.0 and inside the merged branch are absent.
r2: parametrized over every noise subject plus the release PR merge.

r3: template headings, both install lines pinned to the tag, the compare link names v0.2.0 for v0.3.0rc1, no leftover `$`, first release with no compare link, unknown tag exits 1 naming it with empty stdout.
r4: asserts no `--generate-notes`, the script redirect into the notes file and that `--notes-file` uses it, in order.
r6: the ADR names the script.
None.
v0.2.0's Other changes lists `operator: initial commit`.
The plan only skips the `operator: manual commit` placeholder, so this is within contract; the operator may want to see it when reviewing the backfill.
